elektrotechnika.label: Electrical
elektrotechnika.heroSubtitle: Electrical installations. Inspections and servicing. Low-voltage systems.
elektrotechnika.heroLede: We carry out complete electrical installation work for commercial and industrial buildings. We install power and low-voltage systems, and provide inspections, servicing, and a long service life for electrical equipment.
elektrotechnika.overviewHeading: Reliable electrical installations for modern operations
elektrotechnika.overviewText: We handle the design, installation, and servicing of electrical systems — from power and low-voltage wiring through inspections to modern low-voltage systems. We offer complete solutions for new builds, renovations, and building upgrades, with a focus on safety, reliability, and long service life.
elektrotechnika.servicesHeading: The three pillars of the Electrical division

services.title: Complete electrical installations
services.desc: Power and low-voltage wiring, switchboards, electrical connections, power supply and process circuits. Installation, renovation, and upgrades.

services.title: Inspections, servicing, and maintenance
services.desc: Initial and periodic inspections of electrical installations, equipment, appliances, connections, and switchboards up to 1,000 V AC and 1,500 V DC. Servicing, diagnostics, and regular maintenance.

services.title: Low-voltage systems
items: Intruder and fire alarm systems (EZS, EPS).

steps.title: Design and quote
steps.desc: We prepare a technical solution, equipment that meets your requirements, and a tailored price quote.

steps.title: Installation and commissioning
steps.desc: We handle the assembly, installation, and commissioning of the electrical installation and low-voltage systems.

steps.title: Inspection and handover
steps.desc: We carry out the initial inspection, hand over the inspection reports, and provide any follow-up servicing and maintenance.

kovovyroba.label: Metalworking
kovovyroba.heroLede: We take on custom metalwork with a focus on stainless steel and steel structures, railings, staircases, and architectural features. We also grind, satin-finish, and polish stainless steel, brass, copper, aluminium, and other metals.
kovovyroba.overviewHeading: Metalwork with an eye for detail
kovovyroba.overviewText: We specialise in fabricating and installing metal structures for construction, architecture, and interiors. We make stainless steel railings, staircases, handrails, canopies, frames, and bespoke metal features. Our services also include precise metal surface finishing, from fine grinding all the way to a mirror polish.
kovovyroba.servicesHeading: The three pillars of the Metalworking division

services.title: Structural and architectural metalwork
services.desc: Fabrication and installation of stainless steel and steel railings, staircases, handrails, canopies, gates, fencing, substructures, and bespoke metal features for interiors and exteriors.

services.title: Metal grinding and polishing
services.desc: Professional grinding, brushing, satin finishing, and polishing of stainless steel, brass, copper, aluminium, and other metals. Finishes from matte to high gloss and mirror polish.

services.title: Custom fabrication and welding
services.desc: One-off and small-batch production to technical drawings or your own brief. TIG and MIG/MAG welding, assembly of structures, and final finishing of products.

steps.title: Inquiry and consultation
steps.desc: We go over your requirements, technical brief, dimensions, materials, and the finish you want.

steps.title: Design and quote
steps.desc: We propose a suitable technical solution, production method, and surface finish, and prepare a price quote.

steps.title: Fabrication and installation
steps.desc: We handle fabrication, welding, grinding, polishing, and professional installation of the metal elements.

steps.title: Inspection and handover
steps.desc: We carry out a quality check and final touches, then hand over the finished work.

stavebnictvi.label: Construction
stavebnictvi.heroLede: New builds, renovations, and finishing work with a focus on quality, schedule, and clear communication — from foundation to the keys in your hand.

stavebnictvi.overviewText: We handle new builds and renovations — shell construction, masonry and finishing work, and site supervision. Thanks to the connection with our Machinery and Electrical divisions, we can coordinate even technically demanding projects without delays between trades.
stavebnictvi.servicesHeading: The three pillars of the Construction division

services.title: Masonry and finishing work

services.title: Site supervision and project preparation
services.desc: Quality and progress control, coordinating trades, and preparing project documentation.

hero.title: Who we are
hero.lede: Tri-Grid brings three colleagues and three trades together under one name — from electrical through machinery to construction.

story.heading: Three trades, one shared problem
story.text: Tri-Grid is being founded by three colleagues who each have long-standing experience in their own trade — electrical, machinery, and construction. Working on shared projects, they noticed the same problem again and again: coordinating between trades often takes more time and energy than the work itself. They decided to change that and bring their trades together under one name, so the client deals with one point of contact instead of three.

why.heading: What you can expect from us

values.title: One point of contact for three trades
values.desc: No need to find an electrician, machinist, and builder separately — one phone call is enough.

values.title: Coordination without gaps
values.desc: Our divisions communicate directly with each other, so nothing gets lost between trades.

values.title: Direct contact with the founders
values.desc: On every project you deal directly with someone from the team, not through a layer of salespeople.
